caption:
AMD stock fell about 7.7% on Thursday, from $530.14 to around $489 late in the day, after short seller Hunterbrook alleged that blacklisted Chinese server maker IEIT Systems kept using newer AMD firmware. Hunterbrook is short AMD; AMD says the report misrepresents its business and that it complies with US export law.
The report puts AMD's 2025 China and Hong Kong billings at $7.75B (22% of sales), and a US license rule covering Singapore took effect the same day.
